items.title: Internal Discrepancy for Contrastive Learning: Generalization Bounds and Downstream Behaviors
items.title_zh: 对比学习的内在差异：泛化界与下游行为
items.summary_zh: 对比学习已成为训练表示模型的流行范式。尽管先前研究追求更实用、更少限制的假设以增强对对比学习的理论理解，但它们本质上描述的是数据内部或由函数类诱导的表示之间的相互联系。为了概括这些假设，我们提出了内在差异的度量，量化正样本平均表示与潜在聚类中心之间的差异。随后，我们证明了一个感知内在差异的泛化界，适用于对比学习后的下游监督任务，且无需额外假设。该泛化界不仅作为连接各种假设的统一框架，还促使我们进一步减少内在差异，从而引入松弛k-means损失作为近似。此外，我们从对比学习引发的监督损失角度研究对比学习的下游行为。在存在类别不平衡的情况下，我们阐明了对比学习为何能促进不平衡学习。最后，我们研究这些引发的监督损失的最优性，证明了若干有趣的性质。

extra.description: Contrastive learning has emerged as a popular paradigm for training representation models. While prior studies pursue more practical and less restrictive assumptions to enhance theoretical understanding of contrastive learning, they essentially describe the interconnections among representations within the data or induced by the function class. To encapsulate these assumptions, we propose the measure of internal discrepancy that quantifies the difference between the mean representation of positive samples and latent cluster centers. We then prove an internal discrepancy-aware generalization bound for downstream supervised tasks following contrastive learning, without requiring additional assumptions. This generalization bound not only serves as a unifying framework connecting various assumptions but also motivates us to further reduce the internal discrepancy, thereby introducing the relaxed k-means loss as an approximation. Moreover, we investigate the downstream behaviors of contrastive learning from the perspective of contrastive learning-incurred supervised losses. In the presence of class imbalance, we shed light on why contrastive learning can facilitate imbalanced learning. Finally, we investigate the optimality of these incurred supervised losses, proving several intriguing properties.

items.title: Rethinking Representation Geometry in Supervised Contrastive Learning under Long-Tailed Data
items.title_zh: 重新思考长尾数据下监督对比学习中的表示几何
items.summary_zh: 监督对比学习及其平衡变体已证明其在长尾分布下表示学习的有效性。然而，尽管先前分析表明其最优表示可能呈现正单纯形几何，但这种几何是否确实呈现仍未被充分理解。在这项工作中，我们提出了这些目标的理论框架，刻画了最优时是否形成正单纯形。通过将其应用于代表性目标，我们表明这些目标在最优时无法形成正单纯形，因为它们仍然依赖于每类样本数。受此分析启发，我们引入了可应用于对比目标的结构平衡，并提出了一种完全平衡的对比目标，可证明在其最优时形成正单纯形几何。理论和实证结果均表明，所提方法产生了更平衡的表示空间，并改善了长尾识别和迁移学习任务的性能。

extra.description: Supervised contrastive learning and its balanced variants have demonstrated their effectiveness for representation learning under long-tailed distributions. However, although prior analyses suggest that their optimal representations may exhibit a regular simplex geometry, whether such a geometry is indeed exhibited remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we present a theoretical framework for these objectives that characterizes whether a regular simplex is formed at the optimum. By applying this to representative objectives, we show that these objectives fail to form a regular simplex at the optimum because they remain dependent on the number of samples per class. Motivated by this analysis, we introduce structural balancing that can be applied to contrastive objectives, and propose a fully balanced contrastive objective that provably forms a regular simplex geometry at its optimum. Both theoretical and empirical results demonstrate that the proposed method yields a more balanced representation space and improves performance on long-tailed recognition and transfer learning tasks.

items.title: Adaptive Frequency Threshold Byte Pair Encoding for Mixed Natural Language and Structured Symbolic Corpora
items.title_zh: 面向混合自然语言与结构化符号语料库的自适应频率阈值字节对编码
items.summary_zh: 现代语言模型依赖子词分词来定义输入处理的离散单元，通常使用字节对编码（BPE）等方法，将空白视为固定的语义边界。这种设计本质上受限，因为许多有意义的概念——包括多词表达和LaTeX等形式语言的结构化环境——经常跨越空白。虽然最近的超词分词方法试图通过放宽空白约束来解决这一问题，但它们往往依赖贪婪的频率驱动合并，未能考虑词元长度或代表性不足的领域特定语言的具体需求。本文引入自适应频率阈值字节对编码（AdaBPE），一种利用自适应频繁模式挖掘的新分词方法。AdaBPE具有双重动态性：它根据候选词元的长度调整最小频率阈值，以防止偏向频繁的短模式；并根据其类型调整阈值，以区分通用语言和形式语言模式，以LaTeX为例。这使得模型能够高效地将词汇容量分配给领域特定符号（如LaTeX），即使它们在训练数据中仅占很小一部分。我们在涵盖LaTeX和自然语言的五个数据集上评估AdaBPE，显示在领域特定内容上

extra.description: Modern language models rely on subwording tokenization to define the discrete units of input processing, typically using methods like Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) that treat whitespace as a fixed semantic boundary. This design is inherently limited, as many meaningful concepts---including multiword expressions and the structured environments of formal languages like LaTeX---frequently span across whitespaces. While recent superword tokenization methods attempt to address this by relaxing whitespace constraints, they often rely on greedy frequency-driven merging that fails to account for token length or the specific needs of underrepresented domain-specific languages. In this paper, we introduce Adaptive Frequency Threshold Byte Pair Encoding (AdaBPE), a new tokenization method that leverages an adaptive frequent-pattern mining approach. AdaBPE features a twofold dynamicity: it adapts minimum frequency thresholds based on both the length of a candidate token, to prevent favoring frequent short patterns, and its type, to distinguish between general and formal language patterns, using LaTeX as case in point. This allows the model to efficiently allocate vocabulary capacity to domain-specific notations, such as LaTeX, even when they represent a small fraction of the training data. We evaluate AdaBPE across five datasets spanning LaTeX and natural language, showing consistent gains in encoding efficiency and downstream language-model performance on domain-specific content without compromising general-language performance.

items.title: CARES: Coverage-Aware Replay Exemplar Selection for Continual Learning
items.title_zh: CARES：面向持续学习的覆盖感知回放样本选择
items.summary_zh: 基于回放的持续学习通过保留过去样本的缓冲区来缓解灾难性遗忘，在固定内存预算下缓冲区组成至关重要。最近基于核心集的回放方法利用模型导出的梯度、损失或辅助优化来提高缓冲区质量，但随着内存反复更新而产生大量计算开销。我们提出CARES，一种无需持续模型优化的缓冲区构建方法，转而利用冻结预训练特征空间的几何结构，采用类别感知、密度加权的覆盖。我们在在线类别增量和任务增量设置下，跨平衡、不平衡和标签噪声流评估CARES。在Tiny-ImageNet上，CARES比现有基于核心集的选择器快2.3至8.8倍。尽管CARES在不使用持续学习器训练信号的情况下实现此加速，但它在在线类别增量和任务增量设置下的平衡、不平衡和标签噪声流中均位列最先进水平，在类别不平衡下比最强基线高出多达7.58个百分点，同时在Tiny-ImageNet上获得更高的平均准确率。代码将在发表时发布

extra.description: Replay-based Continual Learning mitigates catastrophic forgetting by keeping a buffer of past samples, making buffer composition critical under a fixed memory budget. Recent coreset-based replay methods improve buffer quality using model-derived gradients, losses, or auxiliary optimization, but incur substantial computational overhead as memory is repeatedly updated. We propose CARES, a continual model-optimization-free approach for buffer construction that instead exploits the geometry of a frozen pretrained feature space using class-aware, density-weighted coverage. We evaluate CARES across balanced, imbalanced, and label-noisy streams under online class- and task-incremental settings. On Tiny-ImageNet, CARES is 2.3 to 8.8 times faster than existing coreset-based selectors. Although CARES achieves this speedup using no training signal from the continual learner, it ranks among the state of the art across balanced, imbalanced, and label-noisy streams under online class- and task-incremental settings, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 7.58 percentage points under class imbalance while also attaining higher average accuracy on Tiny-ImageNet. Code will be released upon publication

items.title: An autoencoder outperforms two transformers on prediction of gene expression from chromatin accessibility
items.title_zh: 自编码器在从染色质可及性预测基因表达上优于两个 transformer
items.summary_zh: 从染色质可及性预测 RNA 丰度的模型很少在相同特征、目标和指标下比较。我们在来自 19 项人类研究的 126,604 个配对单核图谱上构建了一个基准，共享 50,000 个峰和 3,185 个基因的词表、十个 5x2 交叉验证折和一个评分目标，并在 70 次训练运行中比较了七个已实现流程和两个参考预测器；每个流程保留自己的输入归一化和原生训练目标。基于双变分自编码器的 scButterfly-B 流程在所有六十个配对折比较中，在每基因和细胞内 Spearman 相关上优于所有 transformer 流程，包括自回归 Perceiver 模型（Omic Translator）和无支持重构的 Cisformer，训练时间短 3.8 倍。Transformer 流程在细胞内轮廓形状上差距为 0.02-0.04，但在每基因相关上落后 0.10-0.24。在两个留出细胞类型上每基因相关较低；对照

extra.description: Models that predict RNA abundance from chromatin accessibility are rarely compared under the same features, targets and metrics. We built one benchmark on 126,604 paired single-nucleus profiles from 19 human studies with a shared vocabulary of 50,000 peaks and 3,185 genes, ten 5x2 cross-validation folds and one scoring target, and compared seven implemented pipelines and two reference predictors across 70 trained runs; each pipeline keeps its own input normalisation and native training target. The scButterfly-B pipeline, built on dual variational autoencoders, outperformed every transformer pipeline, including an autoregressive Perceiver model (Omic Translator) and a support-free reformulation of Cisformer, on per-gene and within-cell Spearman correlation in all sixty paired fold comparisons, with 3.8 times shorter training. Transformer pipelines come within 0.02-0.04 on within-cell profile shape but lag by 0.10-0.24 on per-gene correlation. On two withheld cell types per-gene correlation is low; controls show the podocyte values are typical of within-type correlation for seen cell types of the same size, whereas Paneth values match a cell-agnostic shuffle for every Omic Translator arm. Within the transformer family, prespecified ablations show the Perceiver encoder was worth +0.0439 in within-donor per-gene correlation over full self-attention, a chromosome-aware genomic attention prior reduced it by 0.0096 (exact donor-level sign-flip test, Holm-adjusted p = 1.2e-4), and decoder output order had no detectable effect. A training-mean profile reaches 0.314 within-cell correlation with no input and a constant at the true expressed-gene positions reaches 0.996 per-gene correlation, so oracle-support protocols are reported only as diagnostics. Code, results and an audited release are provided.

items.title: Spatially Informed and Direction Sensitive Representation Learning for Spatial Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: 面向空间转录组学的空间信息感知和方向敏感表示学习
items.summary_zh: 细胞状态由内在基因表达程序和细胞所在的空间微环境共同塑造。空间转录组学使这一背景变得可测量，但有效的表示学习需要同时捕获空间信息分子信号和细胞间组织。现有方法只能部分解决这些挑战：传统基因选择可能忽略空间结构化信号，而编码细胞-细胞关系的方法通常要么将细胞的微环境简化为仅邻近性，丢弃方向，要么依赖与任意组织框架绑定的绝对坐标。因此，具有相似邻居距离但不同空间组织的细胞可能获得过于相似的表示，尽管它们经历着塑造其细胞状态的不同生物背景。我们介绍Tessera，一个空间表示学习框架，同时解决分子选择和细胞背景问题。Tessera将空间信息基因选择与几何归纳偏置相结合，将每个细胞置于其局部组织环境中。通过建模相对细胞-细胞关系，Tessera具有平移不变性同时保留方向，允许邻近细胞根据其空间背景和细胞状态做出不同贡献。在留出组织和技术上，Tessera在表示质量上优于现有空间基础模型，并零样本泛

extra.description: Cellular states are shaped by both intrinsic gene expression programs and the spatial microenvironment in which cells reside. Spatial transcriptomics makes this context measurable, but effective representation learning requires capturing both spatially informative molecular signals and intercellular organization. Existing approaches address these challenges only partially: conventional gene selection can overlook spatially structured signals, while methods for encoding cell-cell relationships often either reduce a cell's microenvironment to proximity alone, discarding direction, or rely on absolute coordinates tied to an arbitrary tissue frame. Consequently, cells with similar neighbor distances but distinct spatial organization may receive overly similar representations, despite experiencing different biological contexts that shape their cellular states. We introduce Tessera, a spatial representation learning framework that addresses both molecular selection and cellular context. Tessera combines spatially informed gene selection with a geometric inductive bias that contextualizes each cell within its local tissue environment. By modeling relative cell-cell relationships, Tessera is translation-invariant while preserving direction, allowing neighboring cells to contribute differently according to their spatial context and cellular state. Across held-out tissues and technologies, Tessera outperforms existing spatial foundation models in representation quality and generalizes zero-shot to contexts up to $16\times$ larger than those seen during training.

items.title: gpuGEM: GPU-based linear optimisation of genome-scale metabolic models
items.title_zh: gpuGEM：基于GPU的基因组尺度代谢模型线性优化
items.summary_zh: 摘要：基因组尺度代谢模型在重复优化工作流中日益挑战CPU线性规划求解器。我们提出gpuGEM，一个使用NVIDIA cuOpt进行基于GPU的GEM优化的开源Python库，具有针对HiGHS和Gurobi验证的尺寸自适应设置。在涵盖四个数量级问题规模的十个模型基准套件中，gpuGEM相对于每个模型更快的HiGHS对偶单纯形和内点法实现了1.1倍至94倍的加速。gpuGEM在十个模型中的三个上也优于Gurobi，加速为1.6倍至2.5倍。在候选基因优先级工作流中，gpuGEM将端到端查询时间从41秒减少到21秒。可用性与实现：gpuGEM在MIT许可证下发布于https://github.com/Digital-Metabolic-Twin-Centre/gpuGEM和PyPI（pip install gpugem）。存档版本（v0.1.2）可在https://zenodo.org/rec

extra.description: Summary: Genome-scale metabolic models increasingly challenge CPU linear-programming solvers in repeated-optimisation workflows. We present gpuGEM, an open-source Python library for GPU-based GEM optimisation using NVIDIA cuOpt, with size-adaptive settings validated against HiGHS and Gurobi. Across a ten-model benchmark suite spanning four orders of magnitude in problem size, gpuGEM achieved speed-ups of 1.1x to 94x relative to the faster of the HiGHS dual-simplex and interior-point methods for each model. gpuGEM also outperformed Gurobi on three of ten models, with speed-ups of 1.6x to 2.5x. In a candidate-gene prioritisation workflow, gpuGEM reduced end-to-end query time from 41 s to 21 s. Availability and Implementation: gpuGEM is released under the MIT licence at https://github.com/Digital-Metabolic-Twin-Centre/gpuGEM and on PyPI (pip install gpugem). An archived release(v0.1.2) is available at https://zenodo.org/records/23422813. gpuGEM requires an NVIDIA GPU, Python 3.11 or later, CUDA 12 and cuOpt 26.6 or later. cuOpt requires a GPU with Volta architecture or newer (compute capability 7.0 or newer). Contact: ronan.mt.fleming@gmail.com Supplementary information: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics
items.title_zh: OmicsBench：AI智能体在研究级生物信息学上的长时程多轮基准
items.summary_zh: 计算生物学家越来越多地将大量分析委托给AI智能体进行长时程、多轮会话，但大多数智能体生物信息学能力基准只提出单一短任务和单次提示。我们提出OmicsBench，一个面向AI智能体的长时程、多轮生物信息学基准。其97个任务各自将依赖子任务连接成有向无环图，总共662个底层子任务。每个子任务作为一个用户轮次提出，并针对答案键进行确定性评分，对错误答案提供可选的上下文反馈。在三种框架上的12个模型中，最慢的智能体平均每任务耗时3.6小时，没有任何组合接近饱和该基准，无上下文反馈时平均得分为0.43至0.57（满分1），有反馈时为0.54至0.67。多轮评估还揭示了单次提示无法发现的行为，因为智能体在依赖早期子任务的子任务上得分较低，而上下文反馈帮助智能体挽回部分损失。由于确定性评分无法定性说明智能体如何失败，我们还引入了一个无监督失败模式发现流程，用于描述、嵌入和聚类智能体的失败尝试，以揭示涌现

extra.description: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt. We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents. Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all. Each subtask is posed as one user turn and graded deterministically against an answer key, with optional in-context feedback on incorrect answers. Across 12 models on three harnesses, the slowest agent averages 3.6 hours per task, and no combination comes near saturating the benchmark, with mean scores of 0.43 to 0.57 out of a possible 1 without in-context feedback and 0.54 to 0.67 with it. Multi-turn evaluation also uncovers behavior that single-shot prompts cannot, as agents score lower on subtasks that depend on earlier subtasks, and in-context feedback helps agents recover some of that loss. Because deterministic scoring gives no qualitative account of how an agent failed, we also introduce an unsupervised failure mode discovery pipeline that describes, embeds, and clusters agents' failed attempts to surface emergent failure modes. Applied to OmicsBench, this pipeline exposes qualitative shortcomings in how agents carry out bioinformatics analyses, ranging from agents applying their own statistical filters in place of the specified ones to agents writing whole answers from memory.

items.title: Truecell reproduces R Seurat's single-cell analysis outputs natively in the Python ecosystem
items.title_zh: Truecell 在 Python 生态中原生复现 R Seurat 的单细胞分析输出
items.summary_zh: 单细胞 RNA 测序分析主要使用 Seurat（R）或 Scanpy（Python），选择通常由编程语言偏好驱动。然而，默认情况下，这些工具产生不同的可变特征、邻居图、聚类和标记基因。需要 Python（支持大多数深度学习、基础模型和代理工具）的实验室必须在无法复现 Seurat 结果的框架中重新实现 Seurat 分析。Truecell 被开发为 Seurat 接口的 Python 实现，保留函数名称、参数、默认设置和对象模型，以促进分析的无缝转移。在十八个与 R Seurat 的配对端到端评估中，确定性输出匹配到浮点精度，并且折叠变化顺序在所有九个差异表达测试中相同。在三个数据集上的三臂基准测试中，固定用户参数和每个工具 20 个种子，Truecell 在所有 12 个数据集和分辨率设置组合中比配置 Seurat 的 Scanpy 更接近地复现 Seurat 的聚类。Truecell

extra.description: Single-cell RNA-sequencing analyses predominantly use either Seurat (R) or Scanpy (Python), with the choice often driven by programming language preference. However, by default, these tools produce divergent variable features, neighbour graphs, clusters, and marker genes. Laboratories requiring Python, which supports most deep-learning, foundation-model, and agent tools, must re-implement Seurat analyses in a framework that does not replicate Seurat's results. Truecell was developed as a Python implementation of the Seurat interface, preserving function names, arguments, default settings, and the object model to facilitate seamless transfer of analyses. In eighteen paired end-to-end evaluations against R Seurat, deterministic outputs matched to floating-point precision, and fold-change order was identical across all nine differential expression tests. In a three-arm benchmark on three datasets, with fixed user parameters and 20 seeds per tool, Truecell more closely reproduced Seurat's clustering than a Seurat-configured Scanpy in all 12 combinations of dataset and resolution settings. Truecell's marker genes and enriched pathways were also closer to Seurat's than Scanpy's were, and pseudobulk DESeq2 reproduced Seurat's gene lists with a Jaccard index ranging from 0.95 to 1.00. This agreement reflects fidelity to Seurat rather than biological correctness.

items.title: LiverHomo: An Integrated and Interactive Human Liver Single-Cell Atlas with Protein Interaction and Cell-Cell Communication Networks
items.title_zh: LiverHomo：一个集成且交互式的人类肝脏单细胞图谱，包含蛋白质相互作用和细胞-细胞通讯网络
items.summary_zh: LiverHomo是一个集成细胞图谱，由公开可用的人类肝脏单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据集开发而成，涵盖健康和多种肝脏疾病背景。虽然已有若干人类肝脏单细胞资源可用，但LiverHomo提供了广泛的疾病覆盖，并通过整合蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络和细胞-细胞相互作用扩展了转录组探索。LiverHomo提供了一个交互式网络门户（https://liverhomo.org），用于探索跨疾病和细胞类型的细胞组成、基因表达、差异表达基因、Gene Ontology注释、细胞-细胞相互作用和上下文特异性PPI网络。为便于直观访问这些多维数据，门户集成了Ask LiverHomo，一个自然语言助手，可解释用户查询并引导用户到相关分析和可视化。交互式直方图、小提琴图、网络可视化和元数据探索使用户能够在细胞、转录组和蛋白质相互作用水平上检查图谱，同时底层数据可随时用于进一步分析。总之，L

extra.description: LiverHomo is an integrated cell atlas developed from publicly available human liver single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) datasets spanning healthy and diverse liver disease contexts. While several single-cell resources for the human liver are available, LiverHomo provides broad disease coverage and extends transcriptomic exploration through the integration of protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks and cell-cell interactions. LiverHomo provides an interactive web portal (https://liverhomo.org) for exploring cellular composition, gene expression, differentially expressed genes, Gene Ontology annotations, cell-cell interactions, and context-specific PPI networks across diseases and cell types. To facilitate intuitive access to these multidimensional data, the portal incorporates Ask LiverHomo, a natural-language assistant that interprets user queries and directs users to relevant analyses and visualizations. Interactive histograms, violin plots, network visualizations, and metadata exploration enable users to examine the atlas at cellular, transcriptomic, and protein-interaction levels, while the underlying data are readily accessible for further analysis. Together, LiverHomo provides an integrated and accessible resource for investigating cellular and molecular alterations across human liver health and disease.

items.title: VGL-stGen: Learning a shared multimodal model for lung histology and spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: VGL-stGen：学习肺组织学和空间转录组学的共享多模态模型
items.summary_zh: VGL-stGen是一个多模态大语言模型，从预训练医学视觉-语言模型改编而来，使用配对的肺H&E和空间转录组学及单细胞参考。训练整合了图像-表达和表达-细胞类型配对，基因条件伪标签将转录组细胞类型监督转移到组织学图像。一个部署的检查点支持十三项评估任务，涵盖组织和细胞类型分类、基因预测以及从组织学、细胞身份和观察到的基因表达组合进行条件表达完成。任务特定解码产生分类标签、基因列表和结构化表达水平。对于条件完成，固定查询基因身份并自回归预测其水平可改善结构化预测。受控适应表明，将监督限制在请求的表达水平标记上可以进一步改善图像条件完成。图像置换实验表明，正确配对的组织学增加了超出观察表达的信息。外部分类部分依赖具有共享注释谱系的计算参考，一些H&E来源在癌症训练或模型开发期间被暴露。在这些条件下，VGL-stGen展示了医学视觉-语言骨干如何从空间转录组学和组织学中学习，通过共享生成建模连接

extra.description: VGL-stGen is a multimodal large language model adapted from a pretrained medical vision-language model using paired lung H&E and spatial transcriptomics with single-cell references. Training integrates image-expression and expression-cell-type pairs, and gene-conditioned pseudo-labels transfer transcriptomic cell-type supervision to histology images. One deployed checkpoint supports thirteen evaluated tasks spanning tissue and cell-type classification, gene prediction and conditional expression completion from combinations of histology, cell identity and observed gene expression. Task-specific decoding produces categorical labels, gene lists and structured expression levels. For conditional completion, fixing queried gene identities and predicting their levels autoregressively improves structured prediction. Controlled adaptation shows that restricting supervision to requested expression-level tokens can further improve image-conditioned completion. Image-permutation experiments indicate that correctly paired histology adds information beyond observed expression. External classification relies partly on computational references with shared annotation lineage, and some H&E sources were exposed during cancer training or model development. Within these conditions, VGL-stGen demonstrates how a medical vision-language backbone can learn from spatial transcriptomics and histology to connect tissue morphology and molecular states through shared generative modeling.

items.title: BARRR: Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression for Multi-View Multi-Cohort Data
items.title_zh: BARRR：用于多视图多队列数据的双向增强降秩回归
items.summary_zh: 跨多个队列（即样本组）和视图（即来源或模态）的双向数据整合在生物医学研究中至关重要，以从异质数据集中获得整体见解。然而，大多数现有整合方法侧重于单一维度，如跨不同来源的多视图整合或跨不同样本组的多队列整合。现有的双向整合方法稀缺且主要无监督，忽视了协变量提供的宝贵见解。为解决这一空白，我们引入双向增强降秩回归（baRRR）方法。我们的方法同时建模协变量相关和不相关效应，同时在两个维度上分解效应水平（全局、部分共享和个体）。大量模拟证明了我们的方法在信号恢复、结果预测和缺失数据插补方面的优势。我们将方法应用于癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）数据，使用体细胞突变作为协变量来告知不同组学平台和癌症类型间的变异模式。这些研究突出了其作为生物医学研究中稳健且适应性强的整合分析工具的潜力。

extra.description: Bidimensional data integration across multiple cohorts (i.e., sample groups) and views (i.e., sources or modalities) is crucial in biomedical research to derive holistic insights from heterogeneous datasets. However, most existing integrative methods focus on a single dimension, such as multi-view integration across distinct sources or multi-cohort integration across distinct sample groups. Existing approaches for bidimensional integration are scarce and predominantly unsupervised, overlooking the valuable insights offered by covariates. To address this gap, we introduce the Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression (baRRR) method. Our approach models covariate-related and unrelated effects concurrently, while also decomposing effect levels (global, partially shared, and individual) across both dimensions. Extensive simulations demonstrate the advantages of our method with respect to signal recovery, outcome prediction, and missing data imputation. We apply our approach to data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), using somatic mutations as covariates to inform patterns of variability across different omics platforms and cancer types. These studies highlight its potential as a robust and adaptable tool for integrative analysis in biomedical research.

items.title: Reducing double-dipping in single-cell topic models with three-way count splitting
items.title_zh: 用三向计数拆分减少单细胞主题模型中的双重 dipping
items.summary_zh: 主题模型从单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中学习基因程序，然后相同的计数被用于测试哪些基因和供体与这些程序相关。计数拆分是这种复用的标准补救措施，但当编码器读取每个细胞的计数时尚未被测试。在一个104,400细胞的狼疮队列中，每次运行300个置换零基因，朴素检验在名义5%水平下拒绝了36%的零基因-主题对，而通常的两向拆分拒绝了38%，因为编码器看到了被检验基因自身的留出计数。在单独的第三个计数上编码主题使用，使用beta-二项稀疏化，将此降低到7.7%（模型外基因为6.7%）；对于另外两个模型LDVAE和scETM，该率为7.0-7.3%（朴素为51-59%）。一个无标签干扰素程序在狼疮队列和预先指定的COVID-19队列的留出计数中发生偏移，供体水平主题使用预测疾病（AUROC 0.96），超越细胞类型比例（两个队列中分别为0.86和0.58）。校准和预测不依赖于模型。我们不

extra.description: Topic models learn gene programs from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data, and the same counts are then used to test which genes and donors are associated with those programs. Count splitting is the standard remedy for this reuse, but it has not been tested when an encoder reads each cell's counts. On a 104,400-cell lupus cohort with 300 permuted null genes per run, naive tests rejected 36% of null gene-topic pairs at a nominal 5% level, and the usual two-way split rejected 38%, because the encoder sees the tested gene's own held-out count. Encoding topic usage on a separate third of the counts, with beta-binomial thinning, lowered this to 7.7% (6.7% for genes outside the model); for two other models, LDVAE and scETM, the rate was 7.0-7.3% (naive 51-59%). A label-free interferon program shifts in held-out counts in the lupus cohort and in a pre-specified COVID-19 cohort, and donor-level topic usage predicts disease (AUROC 0.96) beyond cell-type proportions (0.86 and 0.58 in the two cohorts). Calibration and prediction did not depend on the model. We do not claim better clustering, prediction or topic stability. Code, figures and result tables are public (MIT license; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23307193).

items.title: Understanding Gene Expression-to-Image Learning: Spatial Structure and Information Fidelity
items.title_zh: 理解基因表达到图像学习：空间结构与信息保真度
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）使生物异质性的细胞水平分析成为可能，但从高维、无序基因表达谱学习有效表示仍具挑战性。基因表达到图像（GE2I）通过将基因值排列在像素网格上供卷积神经网络使用，提供了一种有效学习策略，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们在全转录组数据上研究GE2I，同时保持网络和训练过程固定。我们的结果揭示了空间平滑性与基因级保真度之间的权衡。结构化映射产生平滑的低频模式，支持更快的早期优化，而将多个基因分配到同一像素会模糊表达差异并可能降低预测性能。这种权衡解释了为什么当表示许多基因时，随机映射可以与结构化布局竞争。即使图像平滑性降低，一对一基因到像素分配在测试的视觉骨干网络中也能改善预测。我们进一步发现预训练和增强的益处取决于骨干网络和映射。这些发现为像素分配和将视觉先验迁移到基因表达数据提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables cell-level analysis of biological heterogeneity, but learning effective representations from high-dimensional, unordered gene expression profiles remains challenging. Gene Expression-to-Image (GE2I) offers an effective learning strategy by arranging gene values on pixel grids for convolutional neural networks, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We study GE2I on full-transcriptome data while keeping the network and training procedure fixed. Our results reveal a trade-off between spatial smoothness and gene-level fidelity. Structured mappings produce smooth, low-frequency patterns that support faster early optimization, whereas assigning multiple genes to the same pixel obscures expression differences and can reduce predictive performance. This trade-off explains why random mappings can compete with structured layouts when many genes are represented. One-to-one gene-to-pixel assignment improves prediction across the tested visual backbones even when image smoothness decreases. We further find that the benefits of pretraining and augmentation depend on the backbone and mapping. These findings provide practical guidance for pixel allocation and the transfer of vision priors to gene expression data.

items.title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification
items.title_zh: 细胞命运分配中的预测多重性：无标签 Rashomon 集和逐细胞认证的局限
items.summary_zh: 单细胞轨迹推断将转录组测量映射到发育连续体上，但同样拟合数据的配置可能分配冲突的细胞命运。FateMultiplicity 是一个无标签框架，通过评估交叉拟合留出基因上的模型差异，在非劣效性测试下针对随机种子变异进行校准，构建统计可接受的模型集或 Rashomon 集，无需谱系标签。多重性很大，更多取决于模型空间的多样性而非其大小：第二个算法的十二种配置暴露 20.0% 的细胞，而第一个算法的二十四种配置暴露 3.8%。然后测试逐细胞认证命运边际 FM 是否比拟合模型已提供的产生更可靠的分配，结果并非如此。在模拟真实值上，在相同细胞上，FM 以 AUC 0.682 区分错误分配，而基线配置自身的决策边际为 0.965（p = 0.003），种子离散基线为 0.854。信息量由所接纳集的广度而非其基数决定：在基数四时，种子重拟合给出 0.933，超参数扰动集给出 0.701。将下确界放宽到

extra.description: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored. Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: RobustRLlib: A Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
items.title_zh: RobustRLlib：鲁棒强化学习算法的统一库与基准
items.summary_zh: 鲁棒强化学习（RL）对于可靠的现实世界部署至关重要，因为策略可能在各种偏移和干扰下失败。现有鲁棒RL算法提供了丰富的机制和原则，但两个主要障碍限制了其更广泛的潜力：算法可重用性有限和经验能力边界不清晰。我们引入RobustRLlib，一个以算法为中心的库和基准，解决这两个挑战。它在统一接口下集成了17种代表性的鲁棒在线、离线和安全RL算法，大幅提高可重用性，并配备增强的评估平台，涵盖多样化的现实世界偏移以及先进的人形和视觉-语言-动作任务。对273种扰动配置的系统评估提供了当前鲁棒RL算法的最新能力图谱，揭示了它们仍然有效的领域以及持续存在重大鲁棒性差距的领域。作为一个开源、用户友好的平台，RobustRLlib提供了可复现和可扩展的代码库，用于将现有方法应用于新问题并开发新的鲁棒RL算法。

extra.description: Robust reinforcement learning (RL) is critical for reliable real-world deployment, where policies may fail under diverse shifts and disruptions. Existing robust RL algorithms offer a rich set of mechanisms and principles, yet two major barriers limit their broader potential: limited algorithm reusability and an unclear empirical capability boundary. We introduce RobustRLlib, an algorithm-centric library and benchmark that addresses both challenges. It integrates 17 representative robust online, offline, and safe RL algorithms under a unified interface for substantially improved reusability, together with an enhanced evaluation platform spanning diverse real-world shifts and advanced humanoid and vision-language-action tasks. Systematic evaluation over 273 perturbation configurations provides an up-to-date capability map of current robust RL algorithms, revealing where they remain effective and where substantial robustness gaps persist. As an open-source, user-friendly platform, RobustRLlib offers a reproducible and extensible codebase for applying existing methods to new problems and developing new robust RL algorithms.

items.title: Flownomaly: Single-Step Conditional-Mean Recovery for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
items.title_zh: Flownomaly：面向少样本异常检测的单步条件均值恢复
items.summary_zh: 少样本工业异常检测需要仅从少量无缺陷图像中建模类别特定的正常性。常见方法将推理与存储的样本绑定，施加刚性线性结构，或存在重现异常内容的风险。Flownomaly转而将问题视为冻结DINOv2特征空间中的正常对应物恢复。给定正常支持集，通过条件流匹配在冻结的块词元上学习速度场，将高斯噪声输运至正常特征。沿直线路径，使用最优场的一次评估进行单步恢复即可产生干净正常词元的后验均值，无需轨迹积分。操作时间控制恢复对查询词元的修改强度。由于没有异常验证样本可用于调优，仅正常雅可比增益噪声准则仅从支持集选择该时间。查询词元与其恢复对应物之间的平方残差产生异常信号，用于密集定位和图像级检测。在MVTec-AD和VisA上的1、2、4样本基准以及Real-IAD上的样本评估中，Flownomaly针对最近的类别特定方法达到最先进性能。在1样本设置下，MVTec-AD的图像级和像素级AUROC分别达到97.

extra.description: Few-shot industrial anomaly detection requires modeling category-specific normality from only a handful of defect-free images. Common approaches tie inference to stored exemplars, impose rigid linear structure, or risk reproducing anomalous content. Flownomaly instead casts the problem as normal-counterpart recovery in frozen DINOv2 feature space. Given normal supports, a velocity field is learned through conditional flow matching over frozen patch tokens to transport Gaussian noise toward normal features. Along straight paths, a single recovery step using one evaluation of the optimal field yields the posterior mean of the clean normal token without trajectory integration. The operating time governs how strongly recovery modifies a query token. With no anomalous validation samples available for tuning, a normal-only Jacobian gain-to-noise criterion selects this time from the supports alone. Squared residuals between query tokens and their recovered counterparts yield anomaly signals for both dense localization and image-level detection. Across 1-, 2-, and 4-shot benchmarks on MVTec-AD and VisA, together with sample-shot evaluations on Real-IAD, Flownomaly achieves state-of-the-art performance against recent category-specific methods. In the 1-shot setting, image- and pixel-level AUROC reach 97.8% and 98.0% on MVTec-AD and 95.3% and 98.7% on VisA, with a 2.1-point image-level AUROC improvement over the strongest baseline on VisA. Code is available at https://github.com/b-rbmp/Flownomaly.

items.title: Shared clones make random cell halves look reproducible in pooled screens
items.title_zh: 共享克隆使随机细胞半份在汇总筛选中看起来可重复
items.summary_zh: 单细胞扰动筛选用于训练和评估预测扰动效应的模型，模型评分依据测量效应的可重复性来判断。可重复性通常通过将每个扰动的细胞分成两个随机半份来评判。这假设半份是独立重复。然而，在Perturb-seq等汇总筛选中，携带向导RNA的细胞源自有限数量的转导细胞，因此两个随机半份包含相同的克隆：伪重复，其单元在数据中未被标记。使用应无效应的扰动作为对照，我们将随机半份与来自单独转导的独立重复进行比较，并直接用仅克隆不同的半份进行测试。在原代T细胞的全基因组筛选中，零扰动在随机半份之间几乎总是一致，而在独立重复之间仅一半时间一致，这是仅由噪声预期的比率；测量更多细胞并未消除这种一致性。通过T细胞受体恒定区或克隆条形码将细胞分成不共享克隆的半份， largely消除了过度一致性。其大小等于由克隆决定的表达差异份额除以每个扰动的有效克隆数；在16个筛选中，它在转移到小鼠的T细胞和全基因组原代T细胞筛选中最大

extra.description: Single-cell perturbation screens are used to train and evaluate models that predict perturbation effects, and model scores are judged against how reproducible the measured effects are. Reproducibility is usually judged by splitting each perturbation's cells into two random halves. This assumes that the halves are independent replicates. In pooled screens such as Perturb-seq, however, the cells carrying a guide RNA descend from a limited number of transduced cells, so two random halves contain the same clones: pseudoreplication whose unit is not marked in the data. Using perturbations that should have no effect as controls, we compared random halves with independent replicates from separate transductions, and tested directly with halves that differ only in their clones. In a genome-scale screen of primary T cells, null perturbations agreed between random halves almost always and between independent replicates only half the time, the rate expected from noise alone; measuring more cells did not remove this agreement. Splitting the cells into halves that share no clone, by the T-cell receptor constant region or by a clone barcode, largely removed the excess agreement. Its size equals the share of expression differences set by clones divided by the effective number of clones per perturbation; across 16 screens it was largest in T cells transferred into mice and in a genome-scale primary T-cell screen, one to two orders of magnitude smaller in cell lines, and smallest in non-dividing neurons. Shared clones inflate benchmark ceilings and reliability labels, and when a model's input and its scoring answer come from one transduction, published models that predict perturbation effects in a new cell state appear better than a baseline that ignores the perturbation; against cells from another transduction, most fall below it. Reproducibility should be judged across separate transductions.

items.title: Where Rounding Happens Matters: Rounding-Location Alignment Stabilizes LLM Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 舍入发生的位置很重要：舍入位置对齐稳定LLM强化学习
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型的强化学习通常使用独立的推理和训练系统。即使权重和BF16张量相同，实现差异也可能使预期的同策略更新变为异策略并破坏训练稳定性。现有补救措施对齐整个推理和训练栈、改变全局精度或修改学习算法。我们探究在其他实现差异仍然存在的情况下，对齐执行栈的选定部分能否稳定BF16 RL。我们在三个区域——RoPE、SwiGLU和残差RMSNorm——将训练侧舍入位置与推理对齐，通过将选定中间值保留在FP32直到其BF16输出。在四个Qwen系列模型中，对齐所有三个区域防止了默认BF16基线下的崩溃；仅RoPE路径对齐在研究运行中也足够，尽管仍存在数值差异。这些干预保持推理引擎、矩阵乘法和注意力内核以及学习目标不变。

extra.description: Reinforcement learning for large language models often uses separate systems for inference and training. Even with identical weights and BF16 tensors, implementation differences can make an intended on-policy update off-policy and destabilize training. Existing remedies align the entire inference and training stacks, change global precision, or modify the learning algorithm. We ask whether aligning selected parts of the execution stack can stabilize BF16 RL while other implementation differences remain. We align training-side rounding locations with inference in three regions---RoPE, SwiGLU, and residual RMSNorm---by retaining selected intermediates in FP32 until their BF16 outputs. Across four Qwen-family models, aligning all three regions prevents the collapse observed under the default BF16 baseline; RoPE-path alignment alone also suffices in the studied runs, despite remaining numerical discrepancies. The interventions keep the inference engine, matrix-multiplication and attention kernels, and learning objective unchanged.

items.title_zh: 武契奇承认前进党在议会选举中败选，称将以反对党身份开展政治活动，将对塞尔维亚政坛产生哪些影响？
items.summary_zh: 由塞尔维亚学生团体推动的“学生名单-学生获胜”25日宣布，在当天举行的议会选举中获胜。 塞尔维亚前总统武契奇25日承认，由塞尔维亚前进党主导的“亚历山大·武契奇-团结的塞尔维亚”选举联盟在议会选举中败选。塞尔维亚“学生名单-学生获胜”宣布议会选举获胜 塞尔维亚前总统武契奇25日晚承认，由塞尔维亚前进党主导的选举联盟在当天举行的议会选举中败选。 武契奇当天在首都贝尔格莱德竞选总部表示，根据分层抽样结果，由学生团体推动的“学生名单－学生获胜”预计将在国民议会250个席位中获得135至140席，而由塞尔维亚前进党主导的“亚历山大·武契奇－团结的塞尔维亚”选举名单预计获得约105席。 10月25日，在塞尔维亚贝尔格莱德，塞尔维亚前总统武契奇在竞选总部出席发布会 武契奇说，“学生名单－学生获胜”预计获得约220万张选票，其领导的选举联盟预计获得约172万张选票。他表示，接受此次选举结果，并将以反对党

items.title: 卢拉赢得连任，当选巴西新一任总统，怎样看待这一结果？
items.title_zh: 卢拉赢得连任，当选巴西新一任总统，怎样看待这一结果？
items.summary_zh: 在当地时间25日举行的巴西总统选举第二轮投票中，劳工党候选人、现任总统卢拉战胜自由党候选人、前总统雅伊尔·博索纳罗之子弗拉维奥·博索纳罗，当选新一任巴西总统。 巴西高等选举法院数据显示，在已统计的99.80%选票中，卢拉得票率为51.76%，弗拉维奥·博索纳罗为48.24%。卢拉将于2027年1月5日正式就任，任期四年。这是卢拉第四次当选巴西总统。 在首轮投票中，弗拉维奥获得约47%有效选票，居第一位；卢拉以约2个百分点的差距排名第二。根据巴西总统选举规则，第一轮投票中如有候选人得票数过半则直接当选，否则将由得票最多的两人在第二轮投票中决出胜负。 路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦于1945年10月出生。早年领导工人运动，参与创建巴西劳工党。2002年10月，卢拉当选巴西总统，2006年10月连任总统。2022年10月，卢拉第三次当选巴西总统，于2023年1月1日就职。卢拉赢得连任 当选巴西

items.title_zh: 31 省份去年平均工资出炉，全国城镇非私营单位平均工资 129441 元，还有哪些信息值得关注？
items.summary_zh: 根据国家统计局发布的数据，2025年，全国城镇非私营单位就业人员年平均工资为129441元，比上年名义增长4.3%，增速高于上年1.5个百分点，扣除价格因素实际增长4.2%；城镇私营单位就业人员年平均工资为71590元，名义增长3.0%，增速高于上年1.3个百分点，扣除价格因素实际增长2.9%。 需要说明的是，在工资统计调查中的非私营法人单位，包括国有单位、集体单位、联营经济、股份制经济、外商投资经济、港澳台投资经济等单位。整体上，非私营单位的平均工资大幅高于私营单位的平均工资。 分省份看，哪些省份的平均工资更高呢？国家统计局编著出版的《中国统计年鉴2026》，公布了2025年31个省份城镇非私营单位和私营单位的就业人员平均工资数据。从平均工资来看，非私营单位中，12个省份超过12万元，分别是上海、北京、西藏、天津、广东、浙江、江苏、青海、宁夏、重庆、海南和新疆。 其中，上海和北京的非私营

items.title: 毛不易如何公关才能应对这次的「婚礼致辞」事件？
items.title_zh: 毛不易如何公关才能应对这次的「婚礼致辞」事件？
items.summary_zh: 10月20日晚，毛不易在北京出席相识20多年好友周佳奇的婚礼，一段致辞冲上热搜，话题#婚礼发言说虽然不是我的妻子#迅速引发关于“异性友谊边界”和“婚礼发言分寸”的争论。 新娘是毛不易从初中就认识的老同学，两人同走高中、大学岁月，后来又先后到北京，交情超过二十年。 婚礼当天，毛不易讲起两件旧事：高中他厌学低谷时，当班长的佳奇跑到家里给他做了一顿“还比较硬”的菜；大学他在杭州实习，佳奇来出差，趁他上班把乱糟糟的房间收拾干净。他给这位老友的定义是，“把什么事情交给她，你都可以很放心的朋友”。 引发争议的内容有：“从校服到婚纱，虽然不是我的妻子，但是我和佳琪从一开始到今天的全部过程，她每一步走的，我都看在眼里；我每一步走的，她也都在心中。” 毛不易随后又说：“今天结婚当然对咱们现在这个年龄来说，或者现在这个时代来说，越来越不意味着什么了，但是我觉得它起码是你人生的一个新的开始，也是你和张哥感情的一

items.summary_zh: 近日，辽宁沈阳一家三口食用了炒鸡蛋后，相继出现呕吐、腹痛、腹泻等中毒症状。经过调查，这一家人中毒原因是食用了变质鸡蛋，而鸡蛋变质的诱因是保存前曾被清洗过。用水洗鸡蛋再储藏，真的会加速鸡蛋变质吗？专家提示，水洗鸡蛋并不等于“一定中毒”，但确实会提高被污染的风险。正确储存鸡蛋，记住以下几个要点： 鸡蛋不要水洗后存放，以免破坏蛋壳表面的天然胶质保护膜；表面有污物时，可用干布或纸巾擦拭。烹饪前再清洗鸡蛋，清洗后也应尽快烹饪食用。 鸡蛋应放在冰箱冷藏室内部，温度较稳定的位置保存，避免放在冰箱门上，因为频繁开关门会导致温度波动。 鸡蛋储藏的时候要大头朝上、小头朝下竖立存放。日常生活中，如何判断鸡蛋是否已经变质？将鸡蛋放入清水中，可以平躺沉底的鸡蛋新鲜度较好；直立上浮说明存放时间较长；完全漂浮于水面，代表气室已经明显扩大，鸡蛋大概率变质了。摇晃听声法，贴近耳朵轻摇鸡蛋，新鲜鸡蛋几乎听不到晃动水声，如果能

items.title: 从人手一双到无人买单，曾经的「帆布鞋鼻祖」匡威为何卖不动了？年轻人到底想要什么？
items.title_zh: 从人手一双到无人买单，曾经的「帆布鞋鼻祖」匡威为何卖不动了？年轻人到底想要什么？
items.summary_zh: 翻出一张2018年前后的大学宿舍合影，大概率能从中找出一双黑白配色的匡威（Converse）高帮。 那时它是学生、乐手、滑板少年鞋柜里的默认选项之一，配校服不违和，穿进Livehouse也成立。 而同样的街景放到今天，主角已经换成了厚底复古跑鞋、薄底德训鞋或其他户外风格的鞋款。 匡威似乎被很多年轻人悄悄地移出了购物车。映射到业绩，耐克集团2026财年（截至2026年5月31日）财报显示，匡威全年营收约11.7亿美元，同比下滑31%。近期，耐克公布截至8月31日的2027财年第一季度业绩，匡威当季收入2.63亿美元，同比下降28%。 为什么年轻人集体“抛弃”了它？ 三年业绩腰斩 事实上，“命途多舛”这个词贯穿匡威的发展史。 1908年，马奎斯·匡威在美国创立橡胶鞋公司；1917年，品牌推出All Star前身鞋款，1932年前后由篮球运动员查克·泰勒参与改良并冠名；此后半个世纪，提起篮球鞋，

items.title: 如何看待iPhone Duo才开卖一天，网上就很多内屏损坏的案例，而且在同一个位置？
items.title_zh: 如何看待iPhone Duo才开卖一天，网上就很多内屏损坏的案例，而且在同一个位置？
items.summary_zh: 快科技10月24日消息，据海外论坛和小红书多人反馈，苹果iPhone Duo屏幕存在不小的问题，很多人遇到了开箱就爆线开裂的问题。 汇总照片显示几乎全部故障都集中在铰链正上方，多数表现为屏幕一侧浮现一条亮像素线。 一名澳洲用户称设备到手约6小时、开合不到20次，向朋友展示展开时先感到内铰链下方异样，随后听到清晰的咔嚓声，屏幕随即沿铰链裂开，内屏表面与外部铰链均无磕碰或夹痕，他前往Apple Store后苹果直接为其更换了故障机。 国内也有用户称，正常展开屏幕时听到咔嚓一声，折叠处出现一道约3厘米黑色竖裂痕，另有一条较细裂痕贯穿屏幕右半，而且目前已经出现多例类似损坏。 目前来看，应该是iPhone Duo的铰链存在一些问题，但规模不算大，有可能是装配公差导致，而非设计问题，具体情况还有待后续观察。 如果苹果售后检测确认非人为导致，将会给用户更换新机。 如果是认为磕碰导致问题则是要自己付费维修

items.title: 如何看待郑州马拉松一男子系绳带 9 岁儿童跑全马被禁赛三年？儿童跑马拉松有哪些健康风险？
items.title_zh: 如何看待郑州马拉松一男子系绳带 9 岁儿童跑全马被禁赛三年？儿童跑马拉松有哪些健康风险？
items.summary_zh: 带儿童跑马拉松，一男选手被罚！ 据九派新闻报道，日前，有网友发视频称，在10月18日的河南郑州马拉松赛道上，一名男选手用绳子固定在他与一名孩子的腰部，两人一起向前跑步。另有网友称，其参赛时“偶遇9岁‘小孩哥’和其父亲一路奔跑”。 孩子年龄尚小，如何进入赛道，该选手是否违规？10月23日，郑州马拉松组委会工作人员回应称，已对该选手作出处罚，取消成绩并禁赛三年。 《2026“郑州银行”郑州马拉松竞赛规程》明确，马拉松项目的参赛年龄要求为：参赛当年1月1日年满20周岁（2006年1月1日前出生）；半程马拉松项目则要求参赛当年1月1日年满18周岁（2008年1月1日前出生）。 《竞赛规程》亦指出，马拉松比赛是一项高强度长距离的竞技运动，也是一项高风险的竞技项目，对参赛运动员身体状况有较高的要求，参赛运动员应身体健康，有经常参加跑步锻炼或训练的基础，参赛运动员应根据自己的身体状况和能力，选择合适项目

items.title: 网友说「桂花香是一种非牛顿流体」，越用力闻气味越淡，越不用力闻气味越浓，这种说法有道理吗？
items.title_zh: 网友说「桂花香是一种非牛顿流体」，越用力闻气味越淡，越不用力闻气味越浓，这种说法有道理吗？
items.summary_zh: 秋风一起，社交平台上“桂花香是一种非牛顿流体”这一说法突然火了！ 有网友贴切形容它：使劲嗅，几乎闻不到；不找它，风一吹就扑进鼻子里。 有趣的网友甚至将“桂花香”的这种特质和“非牛顿流体”挂上了钩，感觉像极了非牛顿流体“吃软不吃硬”的脾气：轻轻碰它软如水，使劲捶它硬如石。 什么是「非牛顿流体」？这种说法科学吗？https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/7gRcDH8kVFgpmFisQY14Nw

items.title: 媒体批「一有分歧家长就举报」，暴露了哪些问题？家校信任危机该如何破解？
items.title_zh: 媒体批「一有分歧家长就举报」，暴露了哪些问题？家校信任危机该如何破解？
items.summary_zh: 人民日报客户端10月21日刊发评论文章《一有分歧就举报，老师还怎么教孩子》。 文章指出，若让无理举报取代正常沟通，久而久之，家校间本应双向奔赴的信任，很容易在“一有分歧就举报”的惯性中被严重消耗。面对无理举报，教师要按照流程撰写说明、配合核查与谈话，不仅耗费大量工作和私人时间，身心健康也被严重影响。在这样的逻辑下，一个令人寒心的悖论浮现：认真严管可能会带来投诉举报，放任不管说不定反而相安无事。 文章称，当家长、学生和老师回到沟通的正轨，多一些换位思考，既尊重老师的师道尊严和岗位职责，也有效回应家长的合理关切，讲台之上才会重新长出松弛而温暖的教育，孩子们才会在信任的土壤里学会理解，学会成长。 一有分歧就举报，老师还怎么教孩子 据媒体报道，9月开学季，有的学校短短两周就收到近40封举报信。其中大部分举报来自家长，比如“频繁换老师，影响孩子成绩怎么办”“为什么让孩子打扫厕所，没钱请保洁吗”“老师

items.title: 如何看待六小龄童称「圣黛CP」既有意义也很有趣，但需做好正确引导？你认为文艺作品的二创需要设立底线吗？
items.title_zh: 如何看待六小龄童称「圣黛CP」既有意义也很有趣，但需做好正确引导？你认为文艺作品的二创需要设立底线吗？
items.summary_zh: 10月18日，六小龄童回应被刷50亿次的“圣黛CP”改编。他对此予以肯定，表示该创意既有意义又有趣，能吸引一代代人关注传统文化。但他强调，改编应忠于原著、慎于翻新，需做好正确引导与梳理。‌‌ 他表示对此有所了解，“昨天在报纸上看到一则介绍，圣黛CP相关内容播放量已经达到50亿次。这足以说明，一代又一代观众、读者，始终喜爱中国经典名著《西游记》《红楼梦》等作品。有人把央视86版《西游记》里的孙悟空形象，和央视版《红楼梦》中的林黛玉形象融合在一起。《红楼梦》又名《石头记》，而孙悟空正是从石头里诞生的齐天大圣。在我看来，这样的创意既有意义，也很有趣。借助这类对比创意，可以吸引一代代人更多关注传统文化的传承发展，推动各类艺术形式创新。” 与此同时他强调，“我看到《人民日报》刊发了一篇相关文章，观点很有启发性。文章肯定这类创作的主流价值，但也指出，如果部分创作触碰了国家相关政策法规，或是逾越观众心中
